items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They never had you guys play out at that beach resort out there--where Pet Kelly and all them used to play, outside of Houston? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: The Plaza came in after the Gunner, but not directly after. We made a long tour before we--
They never had you guys play out at that beach resort out there--where Pet Kelly and all them used to play, outside of Houston?
